temperature_history_rule: if no observed value exists in any of the three temperature series during the 30-day history, mark all temperature outputs missing_history
rainfall_history_rule: mark rainfall missing_history only if no rainfall observations occur in the 30-day history
snowfall_history_rule: mark snowfall missing_history only if no snowfall observations occur in the 30-day history
missing_auxiliary_policy: training-period median imputation plus missingness indicators
